name: Takahashi Kyouko
source:
She is 33 years old and works as a librarian at a community center.

She is the leader of the "Mama's Club. She knows Jun's situation and therefore takes a sympathetic stance toward him.

She is a pessimistic woman, characterized by her unmotivated behavior and facial expressions. She is always smoking. She is divorced but has no children.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mama-club2.html]official site[/url]]
